items.summary: Recommendation: defer the proposed infrainnovator.com preview and all four CRO proposals this cycle. Evidence: the authoritative candidate list is empty; 39 improvements await measurement, 8 requests failed, only 2 outcomes are proven, and security/operations evidence is incomplete. Revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and not site-attributable; ROI, margin, causal lift, and cost-to-learn are unknown. Smallest next step: delivery-lead records dated unblock evidence and resolves existing repair, measurement, attribution, ownership, and release gates. Owner decision: keep the prepared Woot permission request unsent pending human-counsel review, or authorize it after review.
